messages.subject: Dichotomous Variables in Lavaan Multilevel Model
parts:
Good afternoon everyone,

For my dissertation, I will be running a two-level multilevel model (MLM) that contains a mixture of dichotomous, ordinal, and continuous predictors predicting a dichotomous outcome variable. 

I was able to fit and run this model using lavaan without specifying variables as categorical (they are coded appropriately, e.g., 0 and 1 for dichotomous variables) and got output without any relevant error messages. This page on lavaan's website states that all the data should be continuous when running MLMs in lavaan.

What problems might I run into if I run a multilevel model in lavaan when some of my data are not continuous?

Thank you for however helps out with this question!

Ps. I was able to model missing data using FIML without running into issues as well.
